pages.title: Scroll Symbolizing a Captain
pages.text: A craftable scroll that symbolizes a captain.By giving the Captain Scroll to a Touken Danshi, the player can designate a Touken Danshi as a captain. Through the captain, the player can uniformly control the formation deployment of nearby Touken Danshi.$(br2)There cannot be more than one captain within 16 blocks.$(br2)Touken Danshi of different players will not pick up scrolls dropped by Touken Danshi that are not on their own side.$(br2)See the next page for the recipe.
